about: Every demonstration on the site and the form it takes. scripts/demo-labels.mjs writes each row's label onto its page; tests/test_demo_labels.py checks the labels and the evidence records. The form of each registry module is in its row in world/site/surfaces/registry.mjs.

forms.live: The code runs in the visitor's browser now, on what the visitor gives it.
forms.replay: A recorded run, stepped through or checked again in the visitor's browser. Needs an evidence record.
forms.captured: Output recorded once and shown as recorded. Nothing on the page runs the tool. Needs an evidence record.

evidence: date (ISO day of the run), command (as written in the record), file (the committed record), sha256 (of that file). commandIn names another committed file when the command is written there.

rows.what: The blend table hands its blend and its palette to the lettering, the motion curve and the pen study through the bus.
The type forge mints Zain Mint from six numbers in the browser, sets the visitor's text in it and builds the font file there.
The sound room composes and synthesizes one of five pieces in the browser, plays it on a press and renders it there as a sound file.
The field steps flow, dye and a sound wave in the browser, traces light through them and reads and dimensions what the visitor gives those properties.
The shader room compiles the visitor's fragment shader in the browser and runs it on the visitor's graphics card.
The front bench: an element runs in the well from its own measurements.
Pigment, ink and paper share one well, with the plate and the chart beside it.
Type, ink and paper blended: living type, lettering, the timing curve and a well.
The Fourier room letters a word as Fourier series of the font's outlines, in the tab.
Distill takes a file, an archive or a folder apart in the tab.
CMMNS reads the wording of a pasted passage in the browser.
The 0.4.0 browser build of the native renderer draws a frame and writes its certificate.
The byte witness hashes the visitor's text or file and compares it with a stored target.
The finding's analysis run again in the browser from the study's data, with a seed the visitor can change; each number is set beside the study's own.
Crucible measures a draft, the draft is refined, and the same thesis is measured again.

evidence.command: python -m crucible run thesis.json --substrate substrate-draft.json --registry registry-draft --bundle bundle-draft

rows.what: Forum routes one request, runs it in waves against an offline fixture and verifies its ledger.
Gather extracts a page, stores it by content hash and verifies the corpus.
Index maps three repositories and verifies one dependency claim.
Two chained receipts are sealed and verified, one byte is changed, and the verifier refuses.
A picture of the Flywheel gateway page with its endpoint table.
Flywheel checks three prepared answers against a record: one held as wrong, one released, one held as uncited.
A review packet for one thesis with a MATCH, a DRIFT and an UNVERIFIABLE verdict.

evidence.note: The date is the UTC day of registered_at in the packet's run.json. The command is the one the packet's README gives to regenerate it; run.json does not hold a command line.

rows.what: Articulate's findings on one sample sentence and on its rewrite.
rows.why: The page states Articulate 0.18.0. A rerun to publish the output file needs that release; the copy installed where the labels were made on 14 November 2026 was 0.15.1, so no file was produced.

notYetLabelled.what: three recorded outputs in the home panels (buildc check, a Flywheel verdict, articulate check)
the night school labs, 32 pages of live lessons
the Studio and the tool pages beside it (loom, type forge, gallery, glass and water, the sound page, site music)
sample report pages (emet, proof index, proof surface, public surface sweeper)
